```{r, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
```

### Parameters

```{r}

set.seed(8)

timeout <- 60 # Bargain timeout (bargain window)

n_star <- 23 # Expected number of concessions at timeout

theta <- 0.2 # Ending (terminal) rate of concessions per second of bargaining

# 0.2 = 5 seconds per step

kappa <- 0.075 # Concession rate convergence speed

```

#### Get Starting Rate

Get $Y_{0}$:

$$
Y_0 = \theta + \frac{\kappa(n^* - \theta T)}{1 - e^{-\kappa T}}
$$

```{r}

# Starting rate of concessions per second of bargaining

Y0 <- theta + (kappa*(n_star - (theta*timeout)))/(1 - exp(-(kappa*timeout)))

Y0
```

### Define Rates

Define rate as a function of time:

$$
\lambda(t) = \theta + (Y_0 - \theta)e^{-\kappa t}
$$

With CDF equal to the expected number of concessions at time t:

$$
\mathbb{E}[N_t] = \Lambda{(t)} = \int_0^t \lambda(s)\,ds= \theta t + \frac{Y_0 - \theta}{\kappa}(1 - e^{-\kappa t})
$$

```{r}

lambda <- function(time) {
  
  theta + (Y0 - theta) * exp(-(kappa*time))
  
}

LAMBDA <- function(time) {
  
  theta * time + ((Y0 - theta) / kappa) * (1 - exp(-kappa * time))
  
}

# Verify expectations E(N_t) = n_star

LAMBDA(timeout)

LAMBDA(timeout) == n_star
```

### Define Theoretical Densities

#### Define Segments

```{r}

# Split total time in equally spaced segments

segments <- c()

Nsegments <- 5

for (i in 1:(Nsegments+1)) {
  
  segments[i] <- timeout / Nsegments * (i-1) 
  
}

segments
```

#### Estimate Frequencies and Densities

```{r}

frequencies <- c()

densities <- c()

for (i in 1:length(segments[-1])) {
  
  frequencies[i] <- LAMBDA(segments[i+1]) - LAMBDA(segments[i]) 
  
  densities[i] <- frequencies[i] / LAMBDA(segments[length(segments)])

}

frequencies
sum(frequencies)
densities
sum(densities)

densitySD <- sqrt(densities*(1-densities)/n_star) # Binomial SD
densitySD
```

```{r}

# Calibrate absolute frequency deviations per segment (allowed ranges)

scalingSD <- 0.6

cat("Maximum allowed frequencies: ", frequencies + densitySD * n_star * scalingSD, "\n\n")

cat("Expected frequencies: ", frequencies, "\n\n")

cat("Minimum allowed frequencies: ", frequencies - densitySD * n_star * scalingSD, "\n\n")

cat("Feasible upper: ", floor(frequencies + densitySD * n_star * scalingSD), "\n\n")

cat("Feasible lower: ", ceiling(frequencies - densitySD * n_star * scalingSD), "\n\n")

cat("Upper diff: ", floor(frequencies + densitySD * n_star * scalingSD) - frequencies, "\n\n")

cat("Lower diff: ", frequencies - ceiling(frequencies - densitySD * n_star * scalingSD), "\n\n")
```

### Empirical

```{r}

get_empirical <- function(schedule, segments) { 

  emprirical <- c()
  
  for (i in segments) {
    density <- sum(schedule <= i) / length(schedule)
    
    emprirical <- c(emprirical, density)
  }
  
  error <- abs(densities - diff(c(0, emprirical)))
  
  return(list(error=error, density=diff(c(0, emprirical))))
}
```

### Draw Samples

#### NHPP with Ogata Thinning

Sample from a non-homogenous poisson process using Ogata thinning algorithm:

```{r}

rejectionCount <- 0 # Discarded draws, save for diagnostics

scheduleList <- list()

densityMatrix <- matrix(nrow=0, ncol=Nsegments) # Save for diagnostics

# Get upper bound rate, include rate at time=0 in case rate is decreasing
M <- max(lambda(timeout), lambda(0), theta)

while (length(scheduleList) < 500) {
  
  t <- 0
  
  schedule <- c()
  
  while (t < timeout) {

  interval <- rexp(1, rate=M)
  
  nextTime <- t + interval
  
  if (nextTime > timeout) break
  
  if (runif(1) <= lambda(nextTime)/M) {
    
    schedule <- c(schedule, nextTime)
    
  }
  
  t <- nextTime
  
  }
  
  # Add a random initial delay to avoid jumpy start to the bargain
  
  schedule <- schedule + runif(1, min=1.5, max=3)
  
  # Filter out of range draws (after adding extra initial delay)
  
  schedule <- schedule[schedule < timeout]
  
  # Filter draws that deviate from the theoretical density
  
  empirical <- get_empirical(schedule, segments[-1])
  
  distributionFilter <- sum(empirical$error > scalingSD*densitySD) == 0
  
  # Filter draws that deviate from the expected count (even split equilibrium ensurance)
  
  scheduleLengthFilter <- 20 < length(schedule) & length(schedule) < 26
  
  if (distributionFilter & scheduleLengthFilter) {

    scheduleList[[length(scheduleList) + 1L]] <- schedule
    
    densityMatrix <- rbind(densityMatrix, empirical$density)
    
  } else {
    
    rejectionCount <- rejectionCount + 1
    
  }
  
}
```

#### Check Output

Check output is well behaved

```{r}

cat("Number of rejected draws: ", rejectionCount, "\n\n")

cat("Theoretical densities: ", densities, "\n\n")

cat("Empirical (mean) densities: ", colMeans(densityMatrix), "\n\n")

cat("Theoretical SDs: ", densitySD, "\n\n")

cat("Empirical SDs: ", apply(densityMatrix, 2, sd), "\n\n")

cat("Empirical max: ", apply(densityMatrix, 2, max), "\n\n")

cat("Empirical min: ", apply(densityMatrix, 2, min), "\n\n")

cat("Empirical range: ", apply(densityMatrix, 2, max) - apply(densityMatrix, 2, min), "\n\n")



evenSplitTime <- c()

totalConcessions <- c()


for (i in scheduleList) {
  
  evenSplitTime <- c(evenSplitTime, i[20])
  
  totalConcessions <- c(totalConcessions, length(i))
  
}

cat("Even split time, Mean: ", mean(evenSplitTime), " SD: ", sd(evenSplitTime), " Max: ", max(evenSplitTime), " Min: ", min(evenSplitTime), "\n\n")

cat("Total concessions, Mean: ", mean(totalConcessions), " SD: ", sd(totalConcessions), " Max: ", max(totalConcessions), " Min: ", min(totalConcessions))
```

```{r}

df <- data.frame(EvenSplitTime = evenSplitTime, TotalConcessions = totalConcessions)

ggplot(df, aes(x=EvenSplitTime))+
  geom_histogram(bins=100, fill="springgreen4")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x=TotalConcessions))+
  geom_histogram(bins=5, fill="steelblue")+
  theme_minimal()
```
